title: pnpm permits install scripts for specific packages
description: pnpm-lock.yaml declares an allowlist entry that lets a dependency run its build script. The allowed package executes code with the build user's privileges before any review step, in exchange for a native build the project may not need.
remediation: Keep the allowlist empty unless a native build is required, and record the review for each entry.
limitation: It matches an allowlist entry that lets a dependency run its build script in the parsed pnpm-lock.yaml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
